positive_signals.point: The deck reports $2.1M ARR across 32 clinics, indicating existing commercial deployment.

The stated target customer segment is specific, focusing on outpatient chains and hospitals.

risks.point: The AI auto-coding launch has regulatory requirements still under evaluation, according to the deck.
The reported ARR and retention metrics are not accompanied by cohort definitions or supporting calculations in the supplied materials.

critical_unknowns: What is the pre-money valuation and full preferred-share term sheet?
Which legal entity is the issuer, and how are Agility Health and AgileRPM related?
How are ARR and net revenue retention defined, and what customer cohorts support those metrics?
What regulatory pathway and timeline apply to the planned AI auto-coding model?
Does the $3,500,000 USD historical R&D raised represent all capital raised to date?
